testcase.name: When I getSubscriptionLevels, then I expect the exact 3 defined subscription levels

Given only Card available, when I getSubscriptionAmounts, then I expect BIF and USD
When I getGiftBadges, then I expect exactly 1 badge with the id GIFT
Given only PayPal available, when I getMinimumDonationAmounts, then I expect BIF and JPY
Given all methods are available, when I getBoostAmounts, then I expect BIF and JPY and USD
Given a sub level, When I getBadge, then I expect a sub badge
Given I want to pay in BIF, when I getAvailablePaymentMethods, then I expect CARD and PAYPAL

Given only PayPal available, when I getBoostAmounts, then I expect BIF and JPY
Given I want to pay in USD, when I getAvailablePaymentMethods, then I expect CARD

Given all methods are available, when I getMinimumDonationAmounts, then I expect BIF and JPY and USD
Given GIFT_LEVEL, When I getBadge, then I expect the gift badge
Given only PayPal available, when I getGiftAmounts, then I expect BIF and JPY
Given BOOST_LEVEL, When I getBadge, then I expect the boost badge
When I getBoostBadges, then I expect exactly 1 badge with the id BOOST
